candidates.sentence: We must all unite against extremist Republicans and white supremacists, including former President Donald Trump, who have spent their whole lifes targeting marginalized communities—promoting hate against Black, immigrant, Muslim, Latinx, women, people with disabilities and Jewish-Americans.
Strengthen and protect critical Social Security benefits
Repeal the Republican’s 2017 tax scheme that cut taxes for the nation’s highest earners while driving down revenue for important federal programs that support everyday Americans
Repeal the billions of dollars in tax breaks provided to fossil fuel companies
We must guarantee access to pre-kindergarten, childcare, and invest in debt-free college.
We must eliminate the need to borrow for college, and invest in debt-free college to ensure that everyone, regardless of their income or zip code, has access to a public education.
End the $757 billion that fossil fuel corporations receive in tax subsidies each year
Oppose the privatization of the Veterans Affairs healthcare system and expand funding for physical and mental healthcare for veterans
